title: Japanese-Style Chicken Tsukune with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Italian and Japanese flavors in this delicious chicken skewer dish. Grilled to perfection, it's a perfect meal for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Japanese tsukune sauce
ingredients.notes: or substitute with soy sauce and sake

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together tsukune sauce, Italian dressing, and minced garlic.
Add chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Thread chicken, bell peppers, and onion onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot with additional tsukune sauce and zesty Italian dressing on the side.
Garnish with chopped Italian parsley, if desired.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
